title: Conditional steering as a tamper-resistant refusal: stress-testing CAST on a small model

original_idea.body: Implement a minimal CAST pipeline and red-team the condition trigger with paraphrases/obfuscations to measure how easily the conditional gate is bypassed.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Stress-testing a defense (CAST) for false confidence has a clear chain to deployment-safety; concrete bypass threat.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Implementing a minimal CAST pipeline + adversarial paraphrase red-team is guided; novice + mentor feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable but building the conditional pipeline plus red-team set has a couple of dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Defense stress-testing/red-teaming is exactly external scrutiny labs deprioritize; public methods, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only on one small model; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Adversarial bypass of the CAST condition gate appears largely unexplored.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Red-teaming the CAST condition trigger for bypass is an underexplored stress-test.
